_comment: Pitch-chat は that / this / it / same などの語があると、会話の前の指示をプロンプトにまぜる。だから、これらの語は使わない(generate.py が確かめる)。generate.py が読む絵の指示。prompt = subject + style + (wearable) + (no_face) + background。'icon' という単語は使わない(角丸タイルが付く)。 画像編集では「No tears」のように書くと、かえって涙が出る。だから oops は、出したいものだけを書く。
style: in a soft modern children's mobile game style. Rounded chubby shapes, pastel candy colors, gentle gradients, glossy highlights, tiny sparkles, a thin soft pinkish-brown outline, no harsh black lines.
background: Isolated on a plain flat white background, no frame, no rounded square, no border, no shadow, no text. Square composition. Only one single {noun}, nothing else, fully inside the picture with empty margin on all sides.
lilac_background: plain flat light lavender purple background
wearable: Shown empty, lying by itself, not worn by anyone.

scene_rules._comment: scenes/ の一枚絵(イベントモード)。背景は抜かない。キャラはアプリで重ねるので、下の真ん中を空ける。文字はアプリで重ねる。
scene_rules.composition: Full-bleed illustrated background filling the whole square picture, no frame, no border. Leave open empty space in the lower center for a character to stand: the lower center is plain open ground or floor with nothing on top.
scene_rules.mood: Bright, cheerful, gentle and soft mood. Never dark, never sad, never scary.
scene_rules.no_people: No people, no characters, no text, no letters.
scene_rules.villain_only: No people and no other characters besides the little purple ghost. No text, no letters.
scene_rules.villain: a tiny round chubby cute purple ghost mascot with big round sparkly eyes, a small pointed purple hat, rosy cheeks and a playful little grin, fluffy and soft, clearly not scary
